purpose: Reduce long-term dependence of income on repeated personal labor by validating real demand, unit economics, repeatability, systemization and asset accumulation. No profit guarantee.
frozen_business_source: User-owned V9/V8 operating-system corpus; source document bytes remain outside this public repository.
five_why: Why can a project make money? Identify the profit mechanism as a hypothesis.
Why might that mechanism fail? Attack dependencies and single points of failure.
Why would a real customer act now? Require behavior, not compliments.
Why does revenue become durable cash? Require costs, cash timing and repeat transactions.
Why can income decouple from repeated owner labor? Require SOP/automation/assets that continue to work.

risk_boundary.real_money_gate: No scale-up until real payment and finance evidence exist.
risk_boundary.cash_guard: Net profit and cash flow outrank gross revenue.
risk_boundary.stop_rule: Each project must predefine max loss, timebox and stop condition.
